summary: The chaos experiments confirmed that a single‑replica frontend pod failure caused a 100% error rate for all user‑facing services, and a single‑replica checkoutservice crash produced a 7.1% error rate and integrity violations. A pod kill of redis‑cart resulted in cart data loss and a 1800 ms p95 latency spike, proving the emptyDir volume is non‑persistent. All three failures were mitigated by adding replicas or persistent storage, restoring service health and eliminating integrity violations.

findings.title: Frontend single‑replica pod failure
findings.what_happened: The sole frontend pod crashed, causing a 22.9% error rate for all user‑facing requests and a 70 ms p95 latency spike.
findings.root_cause: The frontend service was configured with only one replica and no PDB or HPA, making it a single point of failure.
evidence: frontend: {"error":"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.251.15:5050: connect: connection refused\""
findings.fix: Increase the frontend replica count to at least two and add a PodDisruptionBudget to prevent simultaneous pod evictions.

findings.title: Redis‑cart pod kill caused data loss
findings.what_happened: Killing the redis‑cart pod dropped all cart items, leading to a 1800 ms p95 latency spike and one integrity violation.
findings.root_cause: The redis‑cart deployment used an emptyDir volume with no PVC, so data did not survive pod restarts.
evidence: same session, cart emptied by the fault
findings.fix: Attach a persistent volume claim to redis‑cart (redis‑persistence) so cart data survives pod termination.

findings.title: Checkoutservice single‑replica pod failure
findings.what_happened: The checkoutservice pod crashed, raising error_rate to 7.1% and causing one integrity violation (HTTP 500 instead of 200).
findings.root_cause: The checkoutservice was deployed with a single replica and no PDB or HPA, creating a single point of failure.
evidence: frontend: {"error":"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.251.15:5050: connect: connection refused\""
findings.fix: Add a second replica and a PodDisruptionBudget to the checkoutservice deployment to eliminate the single point of failure.
